- Removed README.md to clean up outdated or redundant documentation.
- SKILL.md file content has been simplified and trimmed down, removing detailed feature descriptions, install guides, and command lists.
- General information about the skill, including privacy and permissions, has been greatly shortened.
- The new SKILL.md now only provides a brief name and description for the skill.
- 新增了README.md文档，提供技能包的基本说明或使用指南。

xiaomei-skill v0.0.1 初始发布

- 支持双重人格锁定与三级类人记忆模拟，保障人格稳定与真实对话体验

- 覆盖常见日常场景，启动快速，资源占用低
- 内置详细命令管理及权限隐私保护说明
